title: Can I Use Night Cream on My Neck? How to Do It Right
ex: Yes, most face night creams work on the neck. Here is how much to use, how to apply it, and how to be careful with kojic acid on thinner neck skin.
rt: Can I Use Night Cream on My Neck? How-To Guide | Mirc Glow
rd: Can I use night cream on neck skin? Yes. Learn how much to use, how to apply it with upward strokes, kojic acid tips and why sunscreen on the neck matters.
keyword: can i use night cream on neck
quick: Yes, most face night creams are fine on the neck. Neck skin is thinner and drier, so use about half a pea-sized amount, smooth it on with light upward strokes, and start kojic acid creams every other night. Patch test the side of the neck first and wear sunscreen there every morning.
facts: Neck skin is thinner and has fewer oil glands
Use about half the amount you use on your face
Patch test on the side of the neck first
Thick, velvety dark patches need a doctor, not a cream
